scope: Read-only original archive/extracted-source/cache inventory audit. No crate/assets/source/release edits, exporter invocation, Rust build, native execution or new playback acceptance.

causes.finding: available() lists root-level .rig.json only; nested game/ and phase3-staging are absent from the list. manifest.json is used only as a cache-directory sentinel.
Explicitly exports five infantry models and Idle/Jog/Attack1/Die1 only.

Default model-name regex selects Tank|Battleship|Destroyer|Carrier|Artillery|CarArmored; known selected failures reject entire model family. It only exports external View-associated KF sequences, not embedded NIF timelines.
Selects infantry-marked recovered units and at most six gameplay roles; richer KF families and building NIF timelines are intentionally absent.

Rig schema only contains NiKeyframeController node transform tracks; validator admits linear channels plus proven constant Euler bind orientation, not arbitrary embedded property/particle/path/visibility schedules.

recommended_catalog: Use authoritative Data.rwd member path + source SHA + source-local block/sequence identity as catalog keys, not basename or invented clips. Preserve all581 KF sources and743 embedded-controller NIF sources, including currently unsupported entries with explicit reasons.

Separate asset inventory from model/clip associations: KF target-name lists alone do not prove a compatible model; use source TGI declarations/precise native binding, qualified recovered candidate pairs and exact model/source hashes. Do not silently select a model for default Character animations.

Expose cached game/ rigs through an explicit authoritative cache index, deduplicating staged copies by exact model/clip source identity while retaining distinct original sequence/role names. This alone improves discovery but does not add HQ/death playback.

Add embedded NIF controller timeline support with exact source target/property/geometry identity, authored ranges/flags/frequency/phase, visibility/alpha/texture/particle behavior and curve implementations before marking full animations playable. Unsupported channels must not be omitted while displaying a falsely complete death animation.

Prioritize all20 HQ death and5 Corps death NIFs plus77 building death NIFs and119 Pack/Unpack sources; then generals, ambient animals, scenery/weather, effects/projectiles, cutscenes and other authored controller assets. Preserve complete catalog entries even before all playback is implemented.
limits: Existing parsed controller facts are reused only after exact archive and extracted-file byte hashes match. No new NIF parser or native interpolator was executed.
Prior recovered TGI associations are candidate evidence; archived aa-game/aa-net behavior is not a source of truth and must not be revived.
Inventory completeness does not imply animation playback, event/controller scheduling, blending, root motion, battlefield integration or native numeric parity.
No default duration, replacement keyframe, fabricated wheel/motion clip, basename retargeting, or silently dropped unsupported controller is authorized.
